description.zh:
指定要导入KMS凭据的主机ID。
> 仅ECS主机可以导入KMS凭据。您可以调用[ListHosts](~~200665~~)接口获取该参数。
description.en:
The ID of the host to import the KMS secrets to.

> Only ECS hosts can import KMS secrets. You can call the [ListHosts](~~200665~~) operation to obtain this parameter.

description.zh:
堡垒机的实例ID。
> 您可以调用[DescribeInstances](~~153281~~)接口获取该参数。
description.en:
The ID of the Bastionhost instance.

> You can call the [DescribeInstances](~~153281~~) operation to obtain this parameter.

description.zh:
堡垒机的地域ID。
> 地域ID和地域名称的对应关系，请参见[地域和可用区](~~40654~~)。
description.en:
The region ID of the Bastionhost instance.

> For more information about region IDs and names, see [Regions and availability zones](~~40654~~).
The name of the KMS secret.

The type of the KMS secret. Valid values:

- **ECS**: an ECS credential.

title.zh: 导入指定主机的KMS凭据（仅支持V3.2.50及以上版本使用）

example.unifiedCli: aliyun yundun-bastionhost import-kms-secrets-for-host --instance-id bastionhost-cn-st220aw0000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --secrets SecretName=secret SecretType=ECS --host-id 1 --region cn-hangzhou
